textbookText: 39. A hockey puck with a mass of 0.160 kg is at rest at the origin (x=0) on the horizontal and frictionless surface of the rink. At time t=0, a player applies a force of 0.250N to the puck, parallel to the x-axis, he continues to apply this force until t= 2.00 s, (a) what are the position and speed of the puck at t = 2.00 s? (b)If the same force is again applied at t= 5.00 s, what are the position and speed of the puck at t= 7.00 s? (Ans:a. 3.12m and 3.12ms-1 , b. 21.875 m and 6.25 ms-1 ).

40. A chair of mass 12.0 kg is sitting on the horizontal non frictionless floor. You push the chair with a force F = 40.0N that is directed at the angle of 37.00 below the horizontal and the chair slides along the floor. (a) Draw clearly a labelled free-body diagram for the chair. (b)Use your diagram and Newton’s laws to calculate the normal force that the floor exerts on the chair. (Ans: 142N, draw yourself the diagram showing the pushing force at 370 with horizontal)
41. A baseball with a mass of 0.145 kg is moving in the + Y direction with a speed of 0.130 ms-1, and a tennis ball with a mass of 0.0570 kg is moving in the – Y

direction with a speed of 7.80 ms-1. What are the magnitude and direction of the total momentum of the system consisting of the two balls? (Ans:-0.256 kg ms-1 in the – Y direction.).

42. A wireless aerial attached to the top of a mast 20 m high exerts a horizontal force of 600 N upon it of. The mast is supported by a stay wire running to the ground from a point of 6 m below the top of the mast and inclined at 600 to the horizontal. Assuming that the action of the ground on the mast can be regarded as a single force, determine the force in the stay wire. (Ans: 1714.30 N).

43. A typical car weighs about 1200N. If the coefficient of rolling frictionis 0.015, what horizontal force is needed to make the car move with a constant speed of 72 km/hr on a level road? Also, calculate the power developed by the engine to maintain this speed. (Ans: 18N, 360W)
44. A roller whose diameter is 1.0 m weighs 360 N. What horizontal force is necessary to pull the roller over a brick 0.1 m high when the force is applied at the center? (Ans: 270 N)
